proposals.evidence: DEDR5078 explicitly gives Tamil melku be light, mellicu/mellitu soft/fine/thin and Kannada mellitu soft/mild. Badaga melisata light is a comparative adjectival continuation of this softness/thinness family, retaining the survey ending and the elicited light sense. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4205 gives Tamil piṉ, Malayalam pimpu, Kota pibal/piga·r and Kannada pinde/him behind. These southern pin-/pimp-/pih-/in(d)- survey responses retain the documented back/behind stem with ordinary locative extensions and regular Kannada-area loss of initial p/h. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
